repairs.quote: Passive: Rune Prison and Spell Flux refresh this Ability's Cooldown and charge a rune for 4 seconds (max 2 runes). Active: Ryze unleashes a blast, dealing (75/95/115/135/155 + (55% Ability Power) + (2% bonus Mana)) magic damage to the first enemy hit. If the target has Flux on it, it is consumed, causing this Ability to deal 15/40/65/90% increased damage and bounces to nearby enemies with Flux. Ryze also discharges all runes, granting Ryze 28/32/36/40/44% Move Speed for 2 seconds if 2 runes were charged.
